description.p: The Wiicompiled backend of Wheel Wizard is a static-recompilation toolchain for Mario Kart Wii. It enables Wheel Wizard to run the game natively, without relying on a full Wii emulator, by translating a user-supplied, legally obtained copy of Mario Kart Wii into native code. Wiicompiled also supports the Retro Rewind custom track distribution for Mario Kart Wii.
